text: hello. the next thing to do is clear. get the proper layer system in place for 3d meshes, and have the slate blank
resolution: Blank slate + proper 3D-mesh layer system. The Studio scene is now an ordered LIST of EditMesh parts (editors/model/studioModel.ts useStudioModel: parts/activeId/revision with add, duplicate, reorder, rename, delete, visibility), and the viewport boots EMPTY — just the grid + axes, no mesh — per the user's 'start with an empty grid no mesh on it at all'. The OUTLINER reuses the paint editor's LayerStackStrip exactly (editors/model/Outliner.tsx maps parts to LayerStripRowModel rows and wires the same row verbs + +add), honoring 'use that layers component for meshes' with no bespoke list. StudioEditor docks the outliner beside a multi-part viewport (each visible part lowered once per structural revision); +add drops a 1m cuboid for now (the shape dialog is the next slice). The workbench STUDIO tab and StudioRoute both mount StudioEditor; the source.tsx gutter is now thin (one Scene row + a brief global panel). Bundle-clean (Studio.tsx + full sources.ts chain), hot-reloadable, no rebuild.
